subTitle: Have questions about HealthTalks, our expert medical reviews, and community access? Find answers here.

faqs.question: What is HealthTalks and what topics do you cover?
faqs.answer: HealthTalks is an evidence-based health portal, wellness resource, and podcast platform. We cover clinical nutrition, cardiovascular fitness, preventive screening, mental health, chronic condition management, maternal health, and healthy longevity.

faqs.question: Are the articles and talks medically reviewed by licensed professionals?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every article, wellness guide, and expert panel on HealthTalks is created in collaboration with or reviewed by board-certified physicians, registered dietitians, and clinical researchers to ensure scientific accuracy.

faqs.question: Can I submit questions for upcoming live doctor talks and Q&A sessions?
faqs.answer: Absolutely! Community members can submit personal health questions and vote on upcoming session topics. Featured clinicians answer selected listener questions live during each talk.

faqs.question: Is HealthTalks a replacement for personal medical consultation?
faqs.answer: No. HealthTalks provides educational and informational content designed to improve health literacy and empower proactive conversations with your primary care provider. It is never a substitute for direct medical diagnosis or treatment.

faqs.question: How often is new health content and research published?
faqs.answer: We publish evidence-based articles, doctor interviews, and actionable wellness guides multiple times each week, alongside our regular HealthTalks video and podcast episodes.

faqs.question: How can doctors, clinics, or healthcare advocates partner with HealthTalks?
faqs.answer: We welcome collaborations with passionate medical practitioners, researchers, and public health organizations. Reach out through our contact page to speak at an upcoming talk or contribute to our clinical review board.
